validation_policy.unverified: Content has not yet been checked against authoritative documentation or a Junos device.
validation_policy.documentation-checked: Content has been compared against authoritative Juniper documentation.
validation_policy.syntax-validated: Configuration syntax has been accepted by an appropriate Junos syntax or commit validation process.
validation_policy.lab-verified: Content has been tested successfully in a controlled lab environment.
validation_policy.live-device-verified: Content has been verified on the target or equivalent production Juniper SRX device.
validation_policy.deprecated: Content is known to be obsolete or no longer recommended.
validation_policy.invalid: Content has been determined to be incorrect and must not be used.

release_rule: Example or operational content must not be described as live-device-verified unless direct device evidence exists.
